# Acquired PRISM / POWER / IMERG evidence

Accessed 2026-11-15 at 38 N, -101.25 E. `manifest.json` hashes the retained fixture bytes; these are recorded real observations, not synthetic examples. JSON files preserve the provider/adapter values but may be reserialized for readability. PRISM CSV UTF-8 bytes match the corresponding acquired API `snapshotId` (checked against live-route responses); do not normalize line endings.

- `prism-*.csv`: PRISM Group, Oregon State University, https://prism.oregonstate.edu, accessed 2026-11-15. AN91d, 4 km, interpolation off, SI, labelled day ends 12 UTC. Acquired via POST `https://prism.oregonstate.edu/explorer/dataexplorer/rpc.php` using `proc=gridserv`, `call=pp/daily_timeseries`, `spares=4km`, `interp=0`, `stats=ppt tmin tmax`, `units=si`, `range=daily`, compact start/end labels and the point above. Returned `/explorer/tmp/` CSV; terms: https://prism.oregonstate.edu/terms/ . The RPC is not a stable public API contract.
- `power-hourly-*.json`: `https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/hourly/point`, parameters `T2M,PRECTOTCORR`, community AG, point above, compact start/end from filename, format JSON, `time-standard=UTC`. Header API v2.10.4, UTC; C and mm/hour. Hour-label anchoring remains unverified, so the conditional noon recipe is not agreement-classified.
- `power-daily-utc-*.json`: same documented POWER point daily API, parameters `T2M_MIN,T2M_MAX,PRECTOTCORR`, AG, JSON, UTC, compact start/end from filename. Header v2.10.3, UTC; C and mm/day. Used for defensible noon-window bounds, not shifted LST values. NASA POWER Project, NASA Langley Research Center; https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/daily/ .
- `imerg-final-*.json`: freshly acquired using next's `retrieveSubset`, CMR discovery and authenticated GES DISC binary DAP4 point subsets. These are the real adapter outputs (not original binary responses). Final GPM_3IMERGDF V07; native V07B file IDs, per-day constrained URLs, grid, counts and retrieval timestamps are retained. All recorded counts are 48. No token or signed redirect URL is retained. NASA GES DISC; Huffman et al., doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERGDF/DAY/07.

The May 1–3 fixture has no preceding April 30 IMERG observation: bounds must therefore remain missing for that window. The May 9–12 fixture includes the leading UTC day needed for the PRISM May 10–12 target window. Daily UTC values are reported estimates with provider precision, not continuous field measurements; endpoint bounds do not bound measurement error.

Synthetic cases are constructed explicitly inside the tests (known bin positions, near-dry denominators, negative/missing rain, stalled bodies and metadata mutations). They are not passed off as provider observations. See `docs/PRISM-ALIGNMENT.md` for formulas, observed results and operational limits.
